_comment: Risk thresholds, checked by the scanner on every run.
These do not block anything — `toreda order` places whatever you confirm.
They decide when the scanner taps you on the shoulder. Set them to where
you would ACTUALLY want warning: a threshold you intend to ignore is worse
than none, because it trains you to skim the block where real stop-loss
breaches appear.
stopLossPct      Percent from entry at which a position should be sold.
defaultMaxWeight Largest share of the portfolio one symbol may occupy.
trimProfitPct    Gain at which a position past its ceiling becomes a trim.
Overrides are deliberate, dated exceptions with a written reason. The date
and reason are the point: without them, an override is indistinguishable
from drift when you review it six months later. Example:
"overrides": {
"GOOGL": {
"maxWeight": 0.40,
"reason": "Long-term holding; accepting the concentration."
An override raises the SIZE ceiling only. The stop loss applies to every
position without exception — conviction about a company is not a reason to
tolerate an open loss.
